Anthropic is preparing for an IPO at an estimated $965 billion valuation.

Its filings highlight an unusual overlap: Amazon and Google are both investors and cloud providers, while also developing competing AI models.

Anthropic has committed to at least $110 billion in AWS purchases over 10 years; Google has cloud agreements worth at least $114 billion through 2033.
